title: Compare aggregation strategies
brief: Compare equivalent aggregation strategies at the same grain.
instructions: Return every order with independent item revenue and succeeded payment totals.
Calculate revenue from transaction quantity times transaction price.
Use zero for missing totals and preserve all statuses and years.
Compare your primary query against the supplied correlated-subquery baseline.
Report the lower measured median, or equal.
Report whether the median difference exceeds the sum of both MADs.
starterSql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, status FROM orders LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: The starter shows the order grain. The supplied baseline uses independent correlated aggregates. An alternative can preaggregate each detail relation.

hints.text: Aggregate independent detail relations before combining their totals.
Make one item total and one succeeded-payment total for each order, then preserve every order.
Several items and payments on one order multiply totals in a direct detail join. The two strategies need not differ in speed.
